about: v0.5b Kathā story lines (OWNER: WP-C): the new lines inside { "if": "style.katha", "then": [...] } blocks of chapter 4, and the Kathā move descriptions (katha.json moveText) added after v0.5a that were not already in sa-dialogue-5.json at v0.5a, and the new Kathā-only speaker titles there ("label": true). Same format and rules as files 1–5 (notes/sambhashana.md); en and ctx are generated by collectStoryStrings() (file 7), fill sa only.

entries.en: Let us play a game of verses, friend: a chain of lines.
I say a line. You answer with a line that begins with my line's last sound.
entries.sa: अहं पादं वदामि। मम पादस्य अन्तिमेन वर्णेन त्वं पादम् आरभस्व।

entries.en: A fine chain! You know the verses line by line.
entries.sa: साधु! त्वं श्लोकानां पादान् सम्यक् जानासि।

entries.en: Ask each vanara how far he can leap.
entries.sa: सर्वान् वानरान् पृच्छतु। कः कति योजनानि उत्पतितुं शक्नोति?

entries.en: Every vanara has spoken. None can leap a hundred yojanas.
entries.sa: सर्वे वानराः उक्तवन्तः। तेषु कः अपि शतं योजनानि उत्पतितुं न शक्नोति।

entries.en: First hear every vanara: how far can each one leap?
entries.sa: प्रथमं सर्वेषां वानराणां वचनं शृणु। कः कति योजनानि उत्पतितुं शक्नोति?
